Sampled checkout spans for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder carry status error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and status descriptions stating 'failed to charge card: ... Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (evidence 12225891-2ac0-49cd-b065-ac1b3b83df80-t0; trace ids 65dca7b5bbae6a15c5d5df33db6f8e95, ffa5099203779fa3e63d704ef35b215c, b9fd2b9dc7f8766bd33c9046b763bf5b, db1da5b90094e122887c228dae2163b7, 3b505d89be7cf8a098bcec17401afc8d, 7f326949038b8e77fdcfd811e8a51e04, b47636618081f3d607c11caaabac9546, d02fe1153e6b8598fdc6b0a4307dfb17). The only dependency spans that fail are the checkout->payment Charge client spans (rpc.grpc.status_code=2) and the corresponding payment-service spans, which raise ERROR with the same invalid-token message and an exception stacktrace at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 (evidence 12225891-2ac0-49cd-b065-ac1b3b83df80-t0, 12225891-2ac0-49cd-b065-ac1b3b83df80-t1). Rate metrics corroborate: checkout PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR and checkout/payment oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR are nonzero while their STATUS_CODE_UNSET series are zero, and the rpc client count series for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge shows nonzero counts only for rpc_grpc_status_code=2 (evidence 12225891-2ac0-49cd-b065-ac1b3b83df80-t2, 62f5d83c-6f86-41d0-ad98-2a4cded65344-t4, 868872b7-ff9c-487b-b784-cfbe49901551-t0, 868872b7-ff9c-487b-b784-cfbe49901551-t2). Cart, currency, shipping and product-catalog spans in the same window show no error tags, and shipping/currency spans appear successful inside the very traces whose checkout span failed (evidence 62f5d83c-6f86-41d0-ad98-2a4cded65344-t0, 62f5d83c-6f86-41d0-ad98-2a4cded65344-t1, 62f5d83c-6f86-41d0-ad98-2a4cded65344-t2, 868872b7-ff9c-487b-b784-cfbe49901551-t3). Email has no trace results at all in the window, so it is unknown rather than healthy. Latency: p50/p95 values for the payment GetQuote/Charge and product-catalog GetProduct methods stay in the low tens of milliseconds and are essentially flat-to-mildly-drifting across the six 60s steps, but all steps lie inside one 5-minute window with no comparable baseline period, so no latency trend and no latency-driven cause can be supported (evidence 12225891-2ac0-49cd-b065-ac1b3b83df80-t3, 868872b7-ff9c-487b-b784-cfbe49901551-t1). Coverage is partial: the checkout trace search was truncated, the cart and product-catalog trace searches report incomplete=true, latency/count metric responses were truncated, and PlaceOrder's own parent is not visible in the sample, so the full call chain and an exact error ratio are unknown.

claims.text: Sampled checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans failed with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13, with status descriptions 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; affected trace ids include 65dca7b5bbae6a15c5d5df33db6f8e95, ffa5099203779fa3e63d704ef35b215c, b9fd2b9dc7f8766bd33c9046b763bf5b, db1da5b90094e122887c228dae2163b7, 3b505d89be7cf8a098bcec17401afc8d, 7f326949038b8e77fdcfd811e8a51e04, b47636618081f3d607c11caaabac9546, d02fe1153e6b8598fdc6b0a4307dfb17.

The failing checkout PlaceOrder spans have visible child client spans for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=2, and the corresponding payment-service spans (service 'payment', version 2.0.2) also fail with the same invalid-token message plus exception.stacktrace referencing /usr/src/app/charge.js:37; only these two span shapes are error-flagged in the returned checkout/payment samples.

Rate metrics for the window show checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR at approximately 0.0167, 0.0292, 0.0375, 0.0417, 0.0375, 0.025 per second across the six 60s steps, with the same span's STATUS_CODE_UNSET series at 0, and checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR matching those values while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET series is 0.

Payment service error metrics show payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span with STATUS_CODE_ERROR nonzero over the same six steps (about 0.0167 to 0.0417 per second) and rpc client count for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge nonzero only for rpc_grpc_status_code=2 while rpc_grpc_status_code=0 is 0 in every step.

Frontend-side error series move in step with checkout: frontend span-level STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for span 'POST', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and the grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder client span are nonzero, and frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR series are nonzero (about 0.021 to 0.042 per second) alongside much larger STATUS_CODE_UNSET series.

In one affected trace (65dca7b5bbae6a15c5d5df33db6f8e95) the visible failure propagates as HTTP 500 spans: load-generator POST (http.status_code 500), frontend POST (500), frontend-proxy 'ingress' (500) and frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' (500), while the same trace's shipping spans succeed with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 and http.status_code 200.

Dependency spans other than payment show no error tags in the returned samples: 20 cart spans (GetCart/AddItem/HGET/EXPIRE) all have error_by_visible_tags=false over source window 04:17:34-04:20:01Z; 20 currency Currency/Convert spans all carry otel.status_code=OK and rpc.grpc.status_code=0; 20 shipping spans carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 or http.status_code=200; 20 product-catalog spans carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations under about 4.2 ms.

A trace search for service 'email' in the authorized window returned status no_data with result_count 0 and null source_start_at/source_end_at, so no email span evidence was delivered (absence of results is not evidence of zero failures).

Observed rpc client duration quantiles in the window: p95 for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 23.125-24.0625 ms and oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 23.75-24.0625 ms, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct flat at 4.75 ms, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 6.25 rising to 19.0 ms; p50 for Charge 9.167-15.625 ms, GetQuote 12.5-15.625 ms, Convert 2.68-3.08 ms, GetProduct flat at 2.5 ms, CartService/GetCart 3.125-2.5 ms. All six steps fall inside a single 5-minute window with no baseline period supplied.

The label coverage returned by the HTTP server duration count query was limited: only one series was returned, {service_name="cart", http_response_status_code="200"} at roughly 0.17-0.33 per second; no ERROR or per-service HTTP status series for checkout/payment/frontend were delivered in that response.

The checkout error elevation is a consequence of the payment dependency rejecting Charge calls with an invalid-token error, rather than of failures in product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping or email; this is supported by matching error messages, visible checkout->payment parent-child references, and error counts concentrated on the Charge call while the other sampled dependencies show no error tags, but it remains a hypothesis because only parent references actually supplied were used and the sampled view is truncated.

All observed checkout place-order attempts in the window may have failed, since checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR is nonzero in every step while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET series is 0 and the rpc client count for Charge shows only rpc_grpc_status_code=2; this is not established because the metrics responses were truncated and span counts are not unique request counts.

Against a broad dependency-failure explanation, the sampled cart, currency, shipping and product-catalog spans for this window carry no error tags or error statuses, and successful currency and shipping spans appear inside the same traces whose checkout span failed.

Rejected: that elevated dependency latency explains the checkout errors. The observed Charge/GetQuote/GetProduct quantiles stay in the low tens of milliseconds with flat or small drift, and the error payloads are explicit invalid-token rejections; with no comparable baseline period supplied, no latency trend can be inferred or used as a cause.

gaps: Email: trace search returned no_data for the window, so email failures, latency and whether email was ever invoked are unknown, not zero.
